notes: דֵּי שֶׂה is read with the construct carrying the English preposition *for* under rule 19's directional-construct clause; the alternative, marking דֵּי unrepresented and giving *for* to the rectum, is rejected there by name.

*turtle doves* heads on *doves* under rule 31's tie-break, since *dove* is the ASV's ordinary rendering of the same-class יוֹנָה and *turtle* is the specifier; the competing head is recorded on the unit.
*for that wherein* is kept whole on the present אֲשֶׁר under rule 46's first rider, headed on *wherein*.
